features.name: income_to_loan_ratio
features.description: Ratio of income to loan amount, providing a continuous measure of financial capacity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps establish a linear decision boundary for approval by providing a smooth, continuous ratio that scales with repayment ability.

features.name: debt_burden_score
features.description: Interaction between loan percentage of income and interest rate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a smooth severity measure of debt burden suitable for linear margins, allowing the SVM to penalize high-interest, high-burden loans.

features.name: credit_history_to_age_ratio
features.description: Proportion of adult life spent building credit.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a normalized continuous feature that scales linearly with financial maturity, reducing the impact of absolute age.

features.name: normalized_credit_score
features.description: Min-max scaled credit score based on typical credit score ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures smooth gradients and consistent weight updates in linear SVM optimization by keeping the feature scale bounded.

features.name: employment_stability_index
features.description: Ratio of employment experience to adult age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a continuous proxy for career stability that projects well into a linear space, helping separate established workers from transient ones.

features.name: rent_burden_interaction
features.description: Interaction term isolating the loan burden specifically for renters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to assign a distinct weight to the vulnerable subgroup of renters with high loan-to-income ratios.

features.name: high_risk_intent_indicator
features.description: Logical OR of historically riskier loan intents (medical, debt consolidation).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clean binary projection for the SVM margin, grouping similar risk profiles into a single dimension.

features.name: annual_interest_burden
features.description: Estimated annual interest cost in absolute terms.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous financial severity metric that scales linearly with risk, capturing the absolute dollar strain on the borrower.

features.name: log_income_per_year_of_exp
features.description: Log-transformed ratio of income to years of experience.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths out extreme outliers in income and experience, improving linear separability and preventing large margin violations.

features.name: default_history_penalty
features.description: Weighted penalty combining prior defaults with lower credit scores.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a composite risk feature that directly pushes risky profiles away from the decision margin, enhancing linear separability.

features.name: semantic_risk_assessment
features.description: An overall semantic assessment of the applicant's risk profile, considering the interplay between their age, income level, requested loan amount, and the stated intent of the loan.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear, common-sense risk factors that deterministic formulas might miss, providing a smooth continuous score for the SVM.

features.name: semantic_repayment_capacity
features.description: A semantic evaluation of the borrower's capacity to repay the loan, synthesizing their employment experience, education level, and home ownership status into a single continuous score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects complex socio-economic indicators into a single linear dimension, simplifying the margin optimization for the SVM.
